claim_limits: M4A/M4B/M4C are not implemented. impact, versioned edits and history restore remain 404 and are asserted so.
evidence:wave1:integrity exits 1 by design: it asserts no code moved after the Wave 1 freeze, and Wave 2 moved code. Its output is kept verbatim.

The full gate runs at maxWorkers=2. That changes nothing about what is asserted, how long a test may take, or which tests run; it was chosen because this machine cannot sustain the aggregate load of every suite at once.
MT-05's lease timing uses an injected clock and a manual scheduler, not sleeping. A wall-clock lease test would be skipped on a busy machine.
PR-03 is closed on LockService. No test writes a control revision by hand to stand in for a lock.
headed/human experience is NOT_RUN: this wave changes no UI.

Two remaining guards are defence-in-depth and not independently provable, and are recorded rather than given a contrived test: the produced-frame-count check after encoding, and the semaphore release idempotence.
